eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8025 spec refreshed (led by Francesco + Jochem review); CFI for Hegota targeted; much more complete than prior draft
EIP-7709 merged: BlockHash resolved via EIP-2935 system contract (SLOAD); simplifies stateless input; CFI-ready

guest_program_and_spec_updates.highlight: Three releases (B060–B062) on Glamsterdam devnet 7; upcoming V070 targets Glamsterdam devnet 8 (today/tomorrow)
Chain config simplified: schema ID added to public input, chain config removed (only CHAINID retained); Progressive SSZ for state/public keys eliminates gas-limit-dependent list sizing
Guest program handbook published: defines expectations for guest teams (licensing, ELF ownership, CI, dashboards)
ELF generation ownership shifting to each guest program team (Besu, ethrex, Reth, Nethermind in progress); aria/airguest provides tooling only

hive_dashboard_and_tooling.highlight: Hive dashboard now covers Besu, ethrex, Geth, Nethermind, Nimbus (stateful ELs) + guest program/zkVM combos (stateless validators) in one view
Single EEST fixture format now used for tests, benchmarks, devnet blocks, and mainnet blocks across all tooling
opcode count metadata added to benchmark results; feeds directly into EVM gas repricing regression models (EVM Gasfit)

prover_infrastructure.highlight: OpenVM 2.1 benchmarked on mainnet + EEST blocks; reproduces ~2.4s mean proving time for same 1,000-block set
Prover implemented as a target client for benchmarker; forwards requests to distributed proving cluster; supports OpenVM and SP1; results published to GitHub Pages via Benchmarker UI
Cost estimator integration into airguest planned; dashboard for guest performance tracking + correlation analysis with cluster proving times

zkvm_standards.highlight: 10 standards accepted; new draft: proving cost estimation (single metric C, linear to proving time; cost scopes for sub-region measurement)
Marcin Bugaj leaving EF end of August; zkVM guest API standards ownership transfers to Cody

security_and_compliance.highlight: OpenVM 2.1 fully compliant on compliance testing dashboard; SP1 proving support added; zk upgraded to 1.0.0-alpha (one gap, next release)
RISC-V fuzzer (Stefanos, Martin, Varun EF grant) released publicly; found multiple bugs; covers GPU proving across several zkVM provers
Formal RISC-V compliance verification of ZSK: 5 circuit bugs found (6th peripheral); all constraints now confirmed in use

recursive_guest_program.highlight: Francesco: recursive guest client design — execution proof attests to full chain from weak-subjectivity origin to head; eliminates P2P request-response protocol for proofs
Initial implementation in airguest for ethrex and Reth; CI not yet green; early research, subject to rapid change

action_items.action: Review UX impact analysis for EIP-7709 (BLOCKHASH via SLOAD); ping affected projects re: hard-coded gas
Review proving cost estimation standard (large, significant zkVM implementation burden)

decisions.decision: EIP-8025 refreshed spec to be CFI'd for Hegota
EIP-7709 (BlockHash via EIP-2935 system contract) merged and CFI-ready for Hegota
zkVM guest API standards ownership transfers from Marcin Bugaj to Cody upon Marcin's departure end of August

targets.target: V070 guest program release supporting Glamsterdam devnet 8 — today or tomorrow (Aug 12–13, 2026)
